name: Besty AI
description:
Besty AI searches real inventory from professional vacation rental managers, shows day-by-day rate calendars and reviews, produces live quotes with full fee and tax breakdowns, and hands you a checkout link on the property manager's own website with your dates and guests pre-filled. 

Booking direct means no third-party channel markup. Prices come straight from each property's management system,  cached calendars say exactly when they were refreshed, and final totals are always quoted live.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Besty AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Besty AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.besty.ai/consumer/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Besty AI MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Besty AI scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Besty AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Besty AI provides these MCP tools: get_booking_link, get_property, get_rate_calendar, get_stay_quote, and search_stays.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Besty AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Besty AI in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Besty AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Besty AI does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Besty AI is developed by Besty AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
